title: Sodium–hematocrit context and resting pulse: an exploratory incremental temporal-transport test
abstract: In exploratory NHANES 2009–2010 to 2015–2016 temporal transport (n=4859 and 4425), adding a sodium×hematocrit product did not establish improved resting-pulse prediction beyond flexible routine measures: weighted MSE difference -0.044968 beats²/min², joint survey-PSU bootstrap 95% interval [-0.274631, 0.523971].
